Results of simulation study 2, from the output of `1.1.2_Simulation_Fitting.Rmd`:

- Figure 7: TPR and FPR by method and distribution
- Figure 6 and Figures S.4–S.9: example histograms by contamination level
- Figure S.1: iForest+ initialization
- Degenerate fit counts and their effect on TPR and FPR (Section 3.2)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(arrow)
library(cellWise)
library(rrobot)

plot_dir <- "plots"
data_dir <- "data"

pct_levels  <- c("1%", "5%", "10%", "20%", "30%")
dist_levels <- c("Normal", "T", "Laplace", "Gamma", "Chi-Square", "Weibull")
dist_recode <- c(df_normal = "Normal", df_T = "T", df_laplace = "Laplace",
                 df_gamma = "Gamma", df_chisq = "Chi-Square", df_weibull = "Weibull")

tail_type <- function(dist_name) {
  if (dist_name %in% c("df_T", "df_laplace", "df_normal")) "both" else "upper"
}
```

## Data

```{r}
df_results_combined <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "simulation_results_metadata.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(percentage = factor(percentage, levels = pct_levels))

df_diag <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "simulation_diagnostics.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(percentage = factor(as.character(percentage), levels = pct_levels))
```

## Exclusion flags

A SHASH fit is excluded if it is degenerate (more than 1% of transformed values beyond |z| = 20) or if `gamlssML` failed.
Optimizer singular convergence is recorded but not excluded.

```{r}
df_diag <- df_diag %>%
  mutate(
    excl_degen   = degenerate %in% TRUE,
    excl_failed  = fit_failed %in% TRUE,
    excl_optsing = optim_singular %in% TRUE,
    excluded     = excl_degen | excl_failed
  )

failure_summ <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    summarise(
      n_fits       = n(),
      n_degen      = sum(excl_degen),
      pct_degen    = round(100 * mean(excl_degen), 2),
      n_failed     = sum(excl_failed),
      n_optsing    = sum(excl_optsing),
      pct_optsing  = round(100 * mean(excl_optsing), 2),
      n_excluded   = sum(excluded),
      pct_excluded = round(100 * mean(excluded), 2),
      n_retained   = sum(!excluded),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

Degenerate rates by iForest threshold (Section 3.2: 1.3%, 5.3% and 11.2% for SHASH-i at 0.6, 0.55 and 0.5, contamination 1–20%).

```{r}
df_diag %>%
  filter(method %in% c("SHASH-i", "SHASH-z"), thr1 == 3, percentage != "30%") %>%
  group_by(method, threshold) %>%
  failure_summ() %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

Settings used in the paper (thr1 = 3, iForest threshold 0.6).

```{r}
diag_paper <- df_diag %>%
  filter(method %in% c("SHASH-i", "SHASH-z"), thr1 == 3, threshold == 0.6) %>%
  mutate(distribution = recode(distribution, !!!dist_recode))

# per distribution and contamination level
diag_paper %>%
  group_by(distribution, percentage, method) %>%
  failure_summ() %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage), distribution) %>%
  print(n = 100, width = Inf)

# overall, contamination 1–20% (310 SHASH-i and 166 SHASH-z fits)
diag_paper %>%
  filter(percentage != "30%") %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  failure_summ() %>%
  print(width = Inf)

# number excluded per cell
diag_paper %>%
  filter(percentage != "30%") %>%
  mutate(distribution = factor(distribution, levels = dist_levels)) %>%
  group_by(method, distribution, percentage) %>%
  summarise(n_removed = sum(excluded), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = percentage, values_from = n_removed) %>%
  mutate(total = `1%` + `5%` + `10%` + `20%`) %>%
  arrange(method, distribution) %>%
  print(n = 20)
```

Join the exclusion flags (thr1 = 3) onto the per-observation table.

```{r}
excl_wide <- df_diag %>%
  filter(method %in% c("SHASH-i", "SHASH-z"), thr1 == 3) %>%
  mutate(col = ifelse(method == "SHASH-i", "excl_i_thr3", "excl_z_thr3")) %>%
  dplyr::select(simulation, distribution, threshold, percentage, col, excluded) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = excluded)

stopifnot(nrow(excl_wide) ==
          nrow(distinct(excl_wide, simulation, distribution, threshold, percentage)))

df_results_combined <- df_results_combined %>%
  left_join(excl_wide, by = c("simulation", "distribution", "threshold", "percentage"))

cat("rows with no matching diagnostics (SHASH-i):", sum(is.na(df_results_combined$excl_i_thr3)), "\n")
```

## TPR and FPR

TPR and FPR per simulated dataset. Excluded SHASH fits are set to NA; robust z-scoring and RewML involve no SHASH fit and are never excluded.

```{r}
df_metrics <- df_results_combined %>%
  group_by(simulation, distribution, percentage, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    TPR_i_thr3 = if (first(excl_i_thr3) %in% TRUE) NA_real_
                 else sum(flagged_i_thr3 &  true_outliers) / sum(true_outliers),
    FPR_i_thr3 = if (first(excl_i_thr3) %in% TRUE) NA_real_
                 else sum(flagged_i_thr3 & !true_outliers) / sum(!true_outliers),
    TPR_z_thr3 = if (first(excl_z_thr3) %in% TRUE) NA_real_
                 else sum(flagged_z_thr3 &  true_outliers) / sum(true_outliers),
    FPR_z_thr3 = if (first(excl_z_thr3) %in% TRUE) NA_real_
                 else sum(flagged_z_thr3 & !true_outliers) / sum(!true_outliers),
    TPR_flagged_rryj    = sum(flagged_rryj    &  true_outliers) / sum(true_outliers),
    FPR_flagged_rryj    = sum(flagged_rryj    & !true_outliers) / sum(!true_outliers),
    TPR_flagged_emprule = sum(flagged_emprule &  true_outliers) / sum(true_outliers),
    FPR_flagged_emprule = sum(flagged_emprule & !true_outliers) / sum(!true_outliers),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(distribution = recode(distribution, !!!dist_recode))

method_recode <- c(z_thr3 = "SHASH_z_thr1_3", i_thr3 = "SHASH_i_thr1_3",
                   flagged_emprule = "Robust Z-Scoring", flagged_rryj = "RewML Box-Cox/YJ")

mean_by_method <- function(prefix) {
  df_metrics %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(paste0(prefix, "_")), names_to = "method",
                 names_prefix = paste0(prefix, "_"), values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(method = recode(method, !!!method_recode)) %>%
    group_by(distribution, percentage, threshold, method) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(distribution = factor(distribution, levels = dist_levels))
}

dftpr <- mean_by_method("TPR")
dffpr <- mean_by_method("FPR")
```

## Effect of excluding degenerate fits

Section 3.2: excluding degenerate fits changes mean TPR and FPR by less than 0.001 overall.
`metrics_raw` has no exclusions applied.

```{r}
metrics_raw <- df_results_combined %>%
  group_by(simulation, distribution, percentage, threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    TPR_i = sum(flagged_i_thr3 &  true_outliers) / sum(true_outliers),
    FPR_i = sum(flagged_i_thr3 & !true_outliers) / sum(!true_outliers),
    TPR_z = sum(flagged_z_thr3 &  true_outliers) / sum(true_outliers),
    FPR_z = sum(flagged_z_thr3 & !true_outliers) / sum(!true_outliers),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fit_flags <- df_diag %>%
  filter(method %in% c("SHASH-i", "SHASH-z"), thr1 == 3, threshold == 0.6) %>%
  dplyr::select(simulation, distribution, threshold, percentage, method, excl_degen)

perf_long <- metrics_raw %>%
  filter(threshold == 0.6) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TPR_i, FPR_i, TPR_z, FPR_z),
               names_to = c(".value", "method"), names_sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(method = recode(method, i = "SHASH-i", z = "SHASH-z")) %>%
  left_join(fit_flags, by = c("simulation", "distribution", "threshold", "percentage", "method")) %>%
  mutate(distribution = recode(distribution, !!!dist_recode))

stopifnot(!anyNA(perf_long$excl_degen))

# mean TPR and FPR over all fits, kept fits and flagged fits
with_without <- function(d, flag) {
  d %>%
    summarise(
      n_fits   = n(),
      n_flag   = sum({{ flag }}),
      pct_flag = round(100 * mean({{ flag }}), 2),
      TPR_all  = mean(TPR, na.rm = TRUE),
      TPR_kept = mean(TPR[!{{ flag }}], na.rm = TRUE),
      TPR_flag = mean(TPR[{{ flag }}], na.rm = TRUE),
      FPR_all  = mean(FPR, na.rm = TRUE),
      FPR_kept = mean(FPR[!{{ flag }}], na.rm = TRUE),
      FPR_flag = mean(FPR[{{ flag }}], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(dTPR = round(TPR_kept - TPR_all, 4),
           dFPR = round(FPR_kept - FPR_all, 5),
           across(c(TPR_all, TPR_kept, TPR_flag), ~ round(.x, 3)),
           across(c(FPR_all, FPR_kept, FPR_flag), ~ round(.x, 4)))
}

# overall, contamination 1–20%
perf_long %>%
  filter(percentage != "30%") %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  with_without(excl_degen) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

# cells with any degenerate fit, largest FPR change first
perf_long %>%
  filter(percentage != "30%") %>%
  group_by(method, distribution, percentage) %>%
  with_without(excl_degen) %>%
  filter(n_flag > 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(method, distribution, percentage, n_flag, pct_flag,
                FPR_all, FPR_kept, dFPR, TPR_all, TPR_kept, dTPR) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(dFPR))) %>%
  print(n = 30, width = Inf)
```

## Histograms: Figure 6 and Figures S.4–S.9

For each contamination level and distribution, one simulated dataset is drawn at random and refit.
A dataset is used only if RewML, SHASH-z and SHASH-i all give a valid, non-degenerate fit; otherwise another is drawn.
Figure 6 is the 10% set.

```{r}
distributions <- intersect(c("df_normal", "df_T", "df_laplace", "df_gamma", "df_chisq", "df_weibull"),
                           unique(df_results_combined$distribution))
perc_list <- intersect(c("1%", "5%", "10%", "20%"), as.character(unique(df_results_combined$percentage)))
selected_threshold <- 0.6

distribution_names <- c(df_normal = "Normal", df_T = "T", df_laplace = "Laplace",
                        df_gamma = "Gamma", df_chisq = "Chisquare", df_weibull = "Weibull")

method_names <- c(
  "flagged_emprule"       = "Robust Z-Scoring",
  "flagged_rryj"          = "RewML Box-Cox/YJ",
  "flagged_shash_z"       = "SHASH-z",
  "flagged_shash_isoplus" = "SHASH-i"
)

stopifnot("max_abs_z" %in% names(formals(rrobot::SHASH_out)))   # needs the rrobot degeneracy check

valid_shash_fit <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(FALSE)
  if (is.null(fit$x_norm) || length(fit$x_norm) == 0L) return(FALSE)
  !isTRUE(fit$degenerate)
}
```

```{r}
hist_transform <- function(sim_data, dist_name) {
  x    <- unlist(sim_data$outlier_infused_values)
  tail <- tail_type(dist_name)

  yj_trans <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(cellWise::transfo(x, type = "bestObj", robust = TRUE, standardize = TRUE)$Y),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  yj_valid <- !is.null(yj_trans) && length(yj_trans) == length(x) && all(is.finite(yj_trans))
  yj_idx <- if (!yj_valid) integer(0)
            else if (tail == "upper") which(yj_trans > 3)
            else which(abs(yj_trans) > 3)

  fit <- function(method_init) {
    tryCatch(rrobot::SHASH_out(x, thr0 = 2.58, thr1 = 3, thr = 3, tail = tail,
                               method_init = method_init, thr_iso = selected_threshold,
                               maxit = 100),
             error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  shash_z <- fit("emprule")
  shash_i <- fit("isoplus")

  shash_z_valid <- valid_shash_fit(shash_z)
  shash_i_valid <- valid_shash_fit(shash_i)

  list(
    success      = yj_valid && shash_z_valid && shash_i_valid,
    yj_trans     = if (yj_valid) yj_trans else NULL,
    yj_idx       = yj_idx,
    shash_z_norm = if (shash_z_valid) shash_z$x_norm else NULL,
    shash_i_norm = if (shash_i_valid) shash_i$x_norm else NULL,
    shash_z_idx  = if (shash_z_valid) shash_z$out_idx else integer(0),
    shash_i_idx  = if (shash_i_valid) shash_i$out_idx else integer(0)
  )
}

# random simulation, drawn without replacement until all three fits are valid
pick_working_sim <- function(selected_data, dist_name) {
  candidates <- selected_data %>%
    filter(distribution == dist_name) %>%
    pull(simulation) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sample()

  for (sim in candidates) {
    sim_data <- selected_data %>% filter(distribution == dist_name, simulation == sim)
    trans <- hist_transform(sim_data, dist_name)
    if (trans$success) return(list(sim = sim, sim_data = sim_data, trans = trans))
    message("Sim ", sim, " failed for ", dist_name, "; drawing another.")
  }
  stop("No simulation with valid fits for ", dist_name)
}

# warn if the refit flags differ from the stored flags
verify_flags <- function(sim_data, trans, dist_name, sim_num, perc) {
  n <- nrow(sim_data)
  checks <- list(
    "SHASH-z" = list(new = seq_len(n) %in% trans$shash_z_idx, col = "flagged_z_thr3"),
    "SHASH-i" = list(new = seq_len(n) %in% trans$shash_i_idx, col = "flagged_i_thr3"),
    "RewML"   = list(new = seq_len(n) %in% trans$yj_idx,      col = "flagged_rryj")
  )
  for (nm in names(checks)) {
    old <- sim_data[[checks[[nm]]$col]]
    if (all(is.na(old))) {
      warning(nm, ": stored flags all NA (", dist_name, " sim ", sim_num, ")")
      next
    }
    nd <- sum(xor(checks[[nm]]$new, old), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (nd > 0) warning(nm, " mismatch: ", nd, "/", n, " differ (", dist_name,
                        " sim ", sim_num, " perc ", perc, ")")
  }
}
```

```{r}
hist_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y    = element_blank()
  )
outlier_fill <- scale_fill_manual(values = c("Non-Outlier" = "#1B4F72", "Outlier" = "#E67E22"))

build_orig_plot <- function(sim_data) {
  df <- data.frame(x = unlist(sim_data$outlier_infused_values),
                   outlier = ifelse(unlist(sim_data$true_outliers), "Outlier", "Non-Outlier"))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = outlier)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    outlier_fill +
    labs(title = "Outlier-Infused Values", x = "Original Values") +
    hist_theme
}

# histogram on the transformed scale with the N(0, 1) density and the ±3 thresholds;
# the x-axis is cut at 100 when values go beyond it
build_transf_plot <- function(transformed_values, true_outliers, title, dist_name) {
  vlines <- if (tail_type(dist_name) == "upper") 3 else c(-3, 3)

  df <- data.frame(x = transformed_values,
                   outlier = ifelse(true_outliers, "Outlier", "Non-Outlier"))
  binwidth <- diff(range(df$x)) / 40

  norm_curve <- data.frame(x = seq(min(df$x), max(df$x), length.out = 400))
  norm_curve$y <- dnorm(norm_curve$x) * nrow(df) * binwidth

  x_upper <- if (max(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE) > 100) 100 else NA

  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = outlier)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = norm_curve, aes(x = x, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              color = "red", linewidth = 0.3) +
    outlier_fill +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Transformed Values") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(NA, x_upper)) +
    hist_theme
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

chosen_sims_log <- list()   # simulation used for each contamination level and distribution

for (perc in perc_list) {
  perc_label <- gsub("%", "Percent", perc)
  out_dir <- file.path(plot_dir, "thr3", "Histograms", "VaryingPercentage", perc_label)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  selected_data <- df_results_combined %>%
    filter(percentage == perc, threshold == selected_threshold)

  for (dist in distributions) {
    picked   <- pick_working_sim(selected_data, dist)
    sim_data <- picked$sim_data
    trans    <- picked$trans
    chosen_sims_log[[paste(perc, dist, sep = "_")]] <- picked$sim

    verify_flags(sim_data, trans, dist, picked$sim, perc)

    x  <- unlist(sim_data$outlier_infused_values)
    to <- unlist(sim_data$true_outliers)
    emp_trans <- (x - median(x)) / mad(x)

    row_plot <- plot_grid(
      build_orig_plot(sim_data),
      build_transf_plot(emp_trans,          to, method_names[["flagged_emprule"]],       dist),
      build_transf_plot(trans$yj_trans,     to, method_names[["flagged_rryj"]],          dist),
      build_transf_plot(trans$shash_z_norm, to, method_names[["flagged_shash_z"]],       dist),
      build_transf_plot(trans$shash_i_norm, to, method_names[["flagged_shash_isoplus"]], dist),
      nrow = 1
    )
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(distribution_names[[dist]], "-methods.png")),
           plot = row_plot, width = 15, height = 3)
  }
}

print(unlist(chosen_sims_log))
```

## Figure S.1: iForest+ initialization

Uses the datasets chosen for the histograms. The paper shows Normal and Gamma at 20%.

```{r}
build_iforest_init_plot <- function(x, true_outliers, dist_name, thr_iso = 0.6) {
  tail <- tail_type(dist_name)
  init <- outlier_init(x, method = "isoplus", thr_iso = thr_iso, tail = tail, seed = 1)

  plot_df <- data.frame(x = x, iso = init$iso_scores,
                        outlier = ifelse(true_outliers, "True Outlier", "Inlier"))

  lower <- if (tail %in% c("both", "lower") && is.finite(init$cutoff_lower)) init$cutoff_lower else NA_real_
  upper <- if (tail %in% c("both", "upper") && is.finite(init$cutoff_upper)) init$cutoff_upper else NA_real_
  cut_lines <- c(lower, upper)
  cut_lines <- cut_lines[!is.na(cut_lines)]

  y_rng <- range(plot_df$iso, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lab <- y_rng[1] + 0.18 * diff(y_rng)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = iso))

  # shade the flagged region(s)
  if (!is.na(lower)) p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = lower, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                                       fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.6)
  if (!is.na(upper)) p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = upper, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                                       fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.6)

  p <- p +
    geom_point(aes(color = outlier, shape = outlier), size = 1.3, stroke = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Inlier" = "#3B6EA5", "True Outlier" = "tomato")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Inlier" = 16, "True Outlier" = 4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cut_lines, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5)

  for (v in cut_lines) {
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = v, y = y_lab, label = "iForest+ threshold",
                      angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "black", size = 3.2)
  }

  p +
    labs(x = "Outlier-infused values", y = "Isolation forest score", color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 11), axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 4))
}

for (perc in perc_list) {
  out_dir <- file.path(plot_dir, "thr3", "iForestInit", "Manuscript", gsub("%", "Percent", perc))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  for (dist in distributions) {
    sim <- chosen_sims_log[[paste(perc, dist, sep = "_")]]
    sim_data <- df_results_combined %>%
      filter(distribution == dist, simulation == sim,
             percentage == perc, threshold == selected_threshold)

    p <- build_iforest_init_plot(unlist(sim_data$outlier_infused_values),
                                 unlist(sim_data$true_outliers), dist,
                                 thr_iso = selected_threshold)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(distribution_names[[dist]], "-iForestInit.png")),
           p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 400)
  }
}
```

Legend for Figure S.1.

```{r}
legend_df <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2), y = c(1, 1), outlier = c("Inlier", "True Outlier"))

p_legend_src <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = outlier, shape = outlier)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, stroke = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Inlier" = "#3B6EA5", "True Outlier" = "tomato")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Inlier" = 16, "True Outlier" = 4)) +
  labs(color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "thr3", "iForestInit", "Legend.png"),
       ggdraw(cowplot::get_legend(p_legend_src)),
       width = 5, height = 0.6, dpi = 400, bg = "white")
```
